context.stage: WF-03 Step 02 — Design fix for ISS-0073

task.description:
WF-03 Step 02: Produce Type E prose design for ISS-0073.

Root cause: when signinRedirect() is called, the redirect_uri is '/auth/callback' with no realm param. Keycloak does not forward custom query params through the auth code flow, so when the user lands on /auth/callback, resolveRealmFromUrl() has no ?realm= and sessionStorage['bpm_realm_slug'] may not be present, causing fallback to bpm-default.

Two-part fix:

Fix A — Embed realm in redirect_uri:
  When initiating the OIDC flow (signinRedirect call), set redirect_uri = '/auth/callback?realm=<slug>' where <slug> comes from resolveRealmFromUrl() or sessionStorage['bpm_realm_slug'].
  This way, when Keycloak redirects back, the callback URL has ?realm=swiftroute embedded alongside the auth code and state.

Fix B — OidcCallbackPage uses correct manager:
  OidcCallbackPage already calls getOidcManager() which calls fetchTenantConfig → resolveRealmFromUrl.
  With Fix A, resolveRealmFromUrl at callback time will find ?realm=swiftroute in the URL and return the correct realm.
  The existing singleton caching logic should then work correctly — the manager cached will be swiftroute's.
  No separate 'one-time UserManager' is needed IF the redirect_uri embeds the realm.

Document:
  - Where in the code signinRedirect is called
  - How redirect_uri is currently set
  - What to add: read resolveRealmFromUrl(), append ?realm=<slug> to redirect_uri when non-null
  - Security: ?realm= in redirect_uri controls only which OIDC config is used; the auth code validation by Keycloak still enforces that the code was issued by that realm
  - No new functions needed beyond what exists

Design artefact: src/design/iss-0073-oidc-callback-realm.md (Type E)

Run python tools/lint_design_artefact.py src/design/iss-0073-oidc-callback-realm.md

Complete with next_action='Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 02b)'.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers both Fix A and Fix B
Where signinRedirect is called is documented

result.summary: Type E design for ISS-0073: embed realm slug in OIDC redirect_uri. Fix A amends signinRedirect() call sites in ProtectedRoute.tsx and AuthProvider.tsx. Fix B confirms OidcCallbackPage requires no additional change.
